text: [warm] Five seconds. Because your time of useful consciousness up at thirty-nine is measured in a handful of breaths, not minutes.

text: [reflective] Exactly. One hand on the mask, the other stays on the airplane. And here's the part v-one of us used to get wrong, so let me be precise.
